notes: 'Student' only refers to someone studying at a university or college ('Hochschule'). For pupils at primary or secondary school, use 'Schüler'.
The feminine form is 'die Studentin' (plural 'die Studentinnen'). In contemporary German, the gender-neutral plural 'die Studierenden' is also very common.
'Student' is a weak masculine noun (n-declension): it takes the ending '-en' in all cases except the nominative singular (e.g. 'mit dem Studenten').
